segments.sn10.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn10.9:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sukkā bhikkhunī mahatiyā parisāya parivutā dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.sn10.9:1.3: Atha kho sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn10.9:2.1: “Kiṃ me katā rājagahe manussā, madhupītāva seyare;
segments.sn10.9:2.3: Ye sukkaṃ na payirupāsanti, desentiṃ amataṃ padaṃ.

lines: Navame rathikāya rathikanti ekaṃ rathikaṃ gahetvā tato aparaṃ gacchanto rathikāya rathikaṃ upasaṅkamanto nāma hoti.
Gandhamadhupānaṃ pīto kira sīsaṃ ukkhipituṃ na sakkoti, asaññī hutvā sayateva.
Tañca pana appaṭivānīyanti tañca pana dhammaṃ appaṭivānīyaṃ deseti.
Bāhirakañhi sumadhurampi bhojanaṃ punappunaṃ bhuñjantassa na ruccati,“apanetha, kiṃ iminā”ti?
Paṭivānetabbaṃ apanetabbaṃ hoti, na evamayaṃ dhammo.
Imaṃ hi dhammaṃ paṇḍitā vassasatampi vassasahassampi suṇantā tittiṃ na gacchanti.
Yathā hi bāhirāni asambhinnapāyāsādīnipi sappimadhusakkharāhi āsittāni yojitāneva madhurāni ojavantāni honti, na evamayaṃ dhammo.
Ayaṃ hi attano dhammatāya madhuro ceva ojavā ca, na aññena upasitto.
Valāhakameva panthagūti valāhakantarato nikkhantaudakaṃ ghammābhitattā pathikā viya.
“Madhupīkā”ti ettha madhu -saddena madhuviseso vuccatīti āha “gandhamadhupānaṃ pītā viyā”ti.
Sāmaññajotanā hi visese tiṭṭhatīti gandhamadhūti ca ativiya madhuro madaniyo eko madhuviseso.
Pivantī viyāti sukkāya bhikkhuniyā upanīyamānaṃ saddhammāmatarasaṃ attano sotañjaliṃ pūretvā odahantīva.
